preview_heading: Knight Riders meet Kingsmen in Tarouba
preview: Trinbago Knight Riders face Jamaica Kingsmen in CPL 2026 Match 22 at Brian Lara Cricket Academy. The match is scheduled for Mon 31 Aug at 5pm local time.
preview_detail: The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
